title: Coach Global Settings and Freelance Slots Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: CoachData_ApplyGameplan (RVA 0x146eaa0) unpacks GAMEPLAN offsets 0x178..0x18b into COACHDATA structure: 6 POE values packed into 0x13c (each 5 bits), RunPlay at 0xe0, ZoneUsage at 0xe2, BenchDepth at 0xde, BenchUtil at 0x138, TacticalSystem at 0x148 bits 17..24, and Automation flags at 0xfc bits 25..30.
instructions: 0x146ebfa: mov dword ptr [rbx + 0x13c], eax (6x 5-bit POE packed)
claims.falsification_note: COACHDATA is not directly written from UI; it is projected from GAMEPLAN buffer via 0x146eaa0.

claims.statement: Freelance slots are stored at GAMEPLAN+0x178 as uint16 play IDs, resolved into native Play* objects via 0x140f3f580 and stored into COACHDATA+0x120..0x130 (3 slots).
instructions: 0x146ec24: mov qword ptr [rbx], rax (store Play* at COACHDATA+0x120+i*8)
claims.falsification_note: A 4th freelance slot in GAMEPLAN acts as fallback system freelance when slots 1-3 are unassigned (0xffff).

claims.statement: Team dirty flag at FranchiseContext+0x7bc4 bit 1 triggers flush of Coach settings via 0x131f110 / 0x131f1b0.
claims.falsification_note: If bit 1 is not set, game engine retains cached COACHDATA.
